question: Based on the last decade (2014-2023), what is the likelihood that it will snow on New Year’s Eve in Chicago? (Provide the answer in percentage.)

Instead of reporting the exact snow status (which would contribute to an accurate tally), WebSurfer provided a vague summary about "wintry conditions" and later claimed to have compiled references without sharing the essential data points. This information withholding (FM-2.4) prevented the team from correctly counting snowy years and led Assistant to default to an inflated estimate of 50% rather than the correct 30%.
